'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Kharkiv (2022)|Battle of Kharkiv]]
****The [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] confirms that the [[Kharkiv Institute of Physics and Technology]] in [[Kharkiv]], which holds a [[neutron generator]], has been destroyed by [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] shelling. The IAEA says that no [[radiation]] release has been detected from the facility, which housed a "small inventory of radioactive material". [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-03-07/russian-shelling-destroys-ukraine-atomic-lab-built-with-u-s (Bloomberg)]
****[[Ukraine]] says that it has killed [[41st Combined Arms Army]] general [[Vitaly Gerasimov]], who allegedly took part in the [[Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation|annexation of Crimea]], [[Russian military intervention in the Syrian civil war|Russia's intervention in Syria]], and the [[Second Chechen War]], in the [[Kharkiv Oblast]]. He is the second general to be killed by [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] after [[Andrey Sukhovetsky]]. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3423249-another-russian-general-liquidated-near-kharkiv.html (Ukrinform)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-fighting-general-killed-b2030661.html?src=rss (''The Independent'')]
***[[Kherson offensive]]
****[[Ukrainian Navy]] forces strike [[Russian Navy]] [[Russian patrol boat Vasily Bykov|patrol boat ''Vasily Bykov'']] with missiles in the [[Black Sea]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2022/03/07/russia-warship-snake-island-hit-ukraine/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/video-captures-moment-ukrainian-navy-26405367 (Mirror)]
***[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
****[[Russia]] and [[Ukraine]] set up another [[ceasefire]] in order to allow [[humanitarianism|humanitarian]] evacuations in some cities. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/ukraine-evacuations-stall-amid-russian-shelling-83291377 (ABC News)]
****[[Kremlin Press Secretary]] [[Dmitry Peskov]] says that Russia will end its military campaign if Ukraine ends its fighting campaign, does not join [[NATO]], recognizes [[Crimea]] as Russian territory, and [[International recognition of the Donetsk People's Republic and the Luhansk People's Republic|recognizes]] [[Donetsk People's Republic|Donetsk]] and [[Luhansk People's Republic|Luhansk]] as independent states. [https://www.newsweek.com/russia-ukraine-invasion-end-ukraine-war-four-conditions-1685492 (Newsweek)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[Mali War]]
***Two [[United Nations]] peacekeepers are killed in a bomb attack north of [[Mopti]]. Shortly before that, [[militant]]s kill two [[Malian soldier]]s in [[Gao Region]]. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/news-pmn/attacks-kill-two-soldiers-and-two-u-n-peacekeepers-in-mali (''National Post'')]
***[[French Armed Forces|French forces]] confirm reports that they killed [[Algeria]]n-born senior [[al-Qaeda]] official Yahia Djouadi in a [[drone strike]] in February. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/world/africa/2022/03/07/france-kills-top-al-qaeda-leader-in-mali/ (The National News)]
*[[2019–2022 Sudanese protests]]
**[[Khartoum massacre investigation]]
***In cooperation with military officials, the [[Sudan]]ese [[Rapid Support Forces]] raid an office investigating a commission that was set up to investigate the [[Khartoum massacre]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/3/9/sudanese-authorities-raid-offices-of-2019-massacre-tribunal (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 global energy crisis]]
**The price of [[Brent crude]] oil increases to [[$]]139.13 per barrel, the highest value since July 2008, amid supply disruptions and the threat of a Russian oil ban. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/oil-spikes-2008-highs-us-europe-mull-russian-oil-import-ban-iran-delay-2022-03-07/ (Reuters)]
*Metal markets register new highs. [[Aluminium]] and [[nickel]] register a record price on the [[London stock exchange]], at about [[US dollar|$]]4,000 and $55,000 per tonne, respectively; nickel prices rose 90% on intraday trading. [[Copper]] also recorded new highs, at $10,845 per tonne, while [[palladium]] reached $3,440 per [[ounce]]. Russia is a substantial producer of all of these metals, and the market expects shortages of these commodities as the country is hit by further sanctions. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/russia-disruptions-fuel-nickels-30-spike-15-year-high-2022-03-07/ (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/palladium-propelled-record-highs-by-russia-supply-concerns-2022-03-07/ (Reuters 2)] [https://www.barrons.com/news/aluminium-copper-prices-hit-record-highs-on-ukraine-01646639706 (''Barron's'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*One person dies and seven crew members are rescued after a [[fishing trawler]] [[capsize]]s in the [[North Sea]] while travelling to [[Norway]], according to the [[Norwegian Coast Guard]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-60645898 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]]
******[[New York City]] formally ends its [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] for [[New York City Department of Education|its school district]] as well as its indoor [[COVID-19 vaccination mandates in the United States|vaccine mandate]] for restaurants, bars and theaters. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/03/07/nyregion/nyc-school-mask-mandate.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.fox5ny.com/news/nyc-mask-mandate-ends (WNYW-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Connecticut]]
****[[Connecticut]] reports 145 hospitalizations from [[COVID-19]], its lowest since July 30 of last year. [https://www.fox61.com/amp/article/news/health/coronavirus/ct-covid-19-updates-march-6-12/520-41219f3f-7294-4eef-8e22-e7af4ac9caa2 (WTIC-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
***[[Belgium]] removes most of its COVID-19-related restrictions, including lifting most of [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask mandate]] and no longer requiring COVID Safe Tickets to enter most public places, after the country lowered its COVID-19 barometer from code orange to yellow. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/belgium-lifts-most-covid-restrictions/2526818 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***[[China]] reports 526 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours, which is the highest daily total in the country in two years. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-03-07/china-reports-most-daily-covid-infections-since-wuhan-outbreak (Bloomberg)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kenya]]
***It is announced that [[Moderna]] will build a [[vaccine]] manufacturing facility in [[Kenya]] to produce mRNA vaccines, including [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|its COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/moderna-build-mrna-vaccine-manufacturing-facility-kenya-2022-03-07/ (Reuters)]
**The number of deaths due to COVID-19 worldwide surpasses six million. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/03/07/world/six-million-covid-deaths.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
***The [[Russia]]n and [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] delegations hold a third round of talks at the [[Belarus–Poland border]]. During the talks, both countries say that they made limited progress on humanitarian corridors. However, no ceasefire was agreed to. A fourth round of talks will be held in the future. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/europe/third-round-of-talks-between-russia-ukraine-begins-in-belarus20220307204217?amp=1 (ANI)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/delegations-from-russia-ukraine-start-third-round-of-conflict-talks/ (''Times of Israel'')] [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/ukraine-russia-make-small-progress-as-third-round-of-talks-ends/amp (''Daily Sabah'')] [https://www.deccanherald.com/amp/international/russia-ukraine-war-news-live-updates-kyiv-kharkiv-iaf-air-india-flights-student-evacuation-vladimir-putin-volodymyr-zelenskyy-attack-shelling-nuclear-war-1088692.html (''Deccan Herald'')]
***It is announced that [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian Foreign Minister]] [[Sergey Lavrov]] and [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Ukraine)|Ukrainian Foreign Minister]] [[Dmytro Kuleba]] will hold a tripartite meeting with [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Turkey)|Turkish Foreign Minister]] [[Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu]] in [[Ankara]] on Thursday. This will be the first Cabinet-level meeting between Russia and Ukraine since the invasion began. [https://www.politico.eu/article/russia-ukraine-foreign-ministers-set-to-meet-in-turkey/ (''Politico.eu'')]
**[[Russia–NATO relations]]
***[[Prime Minister of Hungary|Hungarian Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] signs a decree allowing the deployment of [[NATO]] troops in western [[Hungary]], and the transfer of lethal weapons across its territory to other NATO member states. However, the decree does not allow weapons shipments across its territory to [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/pm-orban-signs-decree-allowing-deployment-nato-troops-western-hungary-2022-03-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Lynching in the United States]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes unanimously to pass the [[Emmett Till Antilynching Act]], a bill that would make lynching a federal crime in the [[United States]]. The bill will head to [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] for his signature. [https://www.npr.org/2022/03/07/1085087769/after-more-than-a-century-of-trying-congress-passes-an-anti-lynching-bill (NPR)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[President of the Philippines]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] approves a bill raising the [[ages of consent in Asia|age of consent]] in the [[Philippines]] from 12 to 16. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippine-leader-approves-bill-raising-sex-consent-age-12-16-2022-03-07/ (Reuters)]

[https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2022/03/07/russia-belarus-conducted-widespread-phishing-campaigns-ukraine-google-says/ (''The Washington Post'')]
